content_descriptors.notes:
Space-ship battles with ships being destroyed and exploding. Player can act as a pirate and destroy/steal from AI ships. The player can become wanted and even fight/destroy police ships. 

No depiction of bodily remains or blood or viscera of any kind will be shown, nor any visuals of people or animals dying.

Later there will be an addition of illegal substances, such as drugs, cigars, alcohol and perhaps banned(in universe) weapons; that could be traded if the player chooses to play as a trader and chooses to trade such goods.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 and up
  • Processor: Intel i5 Gen 6 and up
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and up
  • Processor: Intel i7 Gen 8 and higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
